intro.h2: A veteran family crew for tile and remodeling
paragraphs: Veteran Tile Works is a veteran-owned tile contractor in Beaumont that local families call for bathrooms, kitchen backsplashes, tile floors and repairs. Google lists it as veteran-owned, women-owned and Latino-owned, and Dan, the name in every review, works on site with his own crew of workers.

What customers mention most is how the job runs. Google groups 13 reviews under cleanliness, and people describe Dan as on time, detail focused and professional. One homeowner hired him to redo tile that someone else had botched. Another called him back for a second bathroom and watched the crew work through a weekend so it was finished before her kids went back to school.

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Full bathroom updates, from tub and shower surrounds with built-in niches to tile floors and new vanities. One repeat customer had her guest bath done with stacked wall tile, hexagon floor tile and a double vanity with brass fixtures.

image.alt: Tub surround with white marble-look subway tile, a shimmering mosaic accent wall and two recessed shampoo niches

items.name: Kitchen backsplashes
items.blurb: New backsplashes that change the look of a kitchen without replacing the cabinets. Past jobs include glass mosaic in blue and gray tones and long stone-look plank tile running neatly around windows, outlets and corners.

image.alt: White kitchen cabinets with a blue and gray glass mosaic tile backsplash behind a white range

items.name: Tile flooring
items.blurb: Flooring is listed among their services. Their photos show wood-look plank tile laid through rooms and doorways, with clean transitions at thresholds. Elizabeth hired the crew to fix a laundry room tile job another contractor had left in bad shape.

image.alt: Wood-look plank tile floor with white baseboard along a yellow wall

items.name: Tile, marble, stone and mini brick
items.blurb: The business offers free estimates for tile, marble, stone and mini brick, plus demolition and remodeling of all surfaces. If you have a wall, floor or counter area in mind, call and describe the material you like.

image.alt: Oak kitchen with white counters and a gray stone-look plank tile backsplash under the cabinets

items.name: Handyman and full remodels
items.blurb: Dan's crew also takes on handyman work and full remodeling, as the owner mentions in replies to reviews. One customer had them repair a laundry room and a garage door as well as the tile, all in the same project.

image.alt: Gray and white glass mosaic backsplash installed between a stainless range and an over-the-range microwave

about.text: Veteran Tile Works is led by Dan, the name in every review, with a crew of workers who stay with him from start to finish. The business is based on Palm Ave in Beaumont and is listed on Google as veteran-owned, women-owned and Latino-owned. Dan's replies to reviews thank veterans and first responder families, and he invites customers to call back for handyman work or a full remodel. Many do. With 46 five-star reviews and more than 300 photos on Google, the work speaks for the crew.
about.owner_role: Leads the crew (named in reviews; owner title and last name not published)

image.alt: No photo of Dan or the crew on file

steps.title: Call for a free estimate
steps.text: Call (909) 561-7249 or email VeteranTileWorks@gmail.com and describe the room, the surface and the tile, marble or stone you have in mind.

steps.title: Talk through your vision
steps.text: Dan looks at the space with you and works out the tile layout, niches and finishes so the result matches what you pictured.

steps.title: Demo and install
steps.text: The crew removes old surfaces where needed, then installs the new tile, keeping the house clean while they work.

steps.title: Final look together
steps.text: When the job is finished you walk the space with Dan and point out anything you want touched up before the crew leaves.

service_area.text: Veteran Tile Works is based at 1001 Palm Ave in Beaumont, CA, and its project posts are from Beaumont. The crew handles bathrooms, kitchen backsplashes, floors and repairs for homeowners around town. If you live nearby and are not sure whether your home is in range, call Dan with your address and a short description of the job and he will let you know.

items.a: Yes. Veteran Tile Works offers free estimates for tile, marble, stone and mini brick, along with demolition and remodeling of all surfaces. Call (909) 561-7249 or email VeteranTileWorks@gmail.com with a few photos of the space and a short note about what you want done.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: Bathroom remodels, kitchen backsplashes, tile floors and full kitchen and bathroom remodeling, plus handyman work. Past jobs include tub surrounds with niches, glass mosaic backsplashes, wood-look tile floors and a laundry room repair after another contractor left a poor tile job behind.

Yes. The Google Business Profile lists Veteran Tile Works as veteran-owned, and also as women-owned and Latino-owned. The owner regularly thanks veteran and first responder families in his replies to reviews, and one veteran customer wrote that Dan treated his family well.

The business is at 1001 Palm Ave, Beaumont, CA 92223, and its posted projects are in Beaumont. If you live outside Beaumont, call (909) 561-7249 with your address and the job you have in mind to check whether the crew can take it on.

items.q: Can you fix tile work someone else did badly?
items.a: Yes. One customer hired Dan specifically to redo a laundry room, garage door and tile job that another contractor had done poorly. She said Dan was on time, detail focused and professional, and that she would hire him for more jobs.

final_cta.text: Call Dan for a free estimate on your bathroom, backsplash or floor.
